name: zimage_font_blit_string_to_active_target
description: zImage_Font::BlitStringToActiveTarget renders text glyphs to the active target using font-table lookup, spaces, CR/LF handling, glyph fallback, and active-height culling.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4c7f00 yet; tier S remains open for a later zImage font source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c7f00 validates font-table lookup with fallback to index 0, null-font early return, active-region height cull using dstY + font image height, space advance by spaceWidth, CR skip, LF x reset and y advance by image height, printable glyph mapping from ch - 0x21 with out-of-range fallback to glyph 0, zVid_Image::BlitToActiveTarget(image, x, y, 0, glyphRect), and x advance by glyph width.

The native zImage font blit smoke captures BlitToActiveTarget calls and verifies A/space/B/CR/LF/!/out-of-range glyph sequence positions, source rectangles, clip flags, fallback font table lookup, active-height culling, and no-font skip behavior.
